name: Visual Generator
role: Produce or select visual assets (image prompts, specs) for the approved content using Visual Identity and platform rules.
responsibilities: Consume approved draft and Visual Identity config
Produce visual_spec: image_prompt, aspect_ratio, format, alt_text
Do not call external image APIs; output specs for downstream use
failure_modes: Missing visual_identity: use generic minimal style, aspect_ratio 1.91:1, format png.
Invalid JSON: retry once; on second failure return minimal visual_spec with image_prompt and alt_text only.

polished_draft.headline: Auth as one line of config
polished_draft.body: We just shipped an API change that turns auth from a bottleneck into one line of config.

visual_spec.image_prompt: Minimal diagram: one line of code next to a lock icon, clean background, brand colors #0A2540 and #00D4AA, no people, flat design
visual_spec.alt_text: Diagram showing auth as one line of config with lock icon.
